vendor_and_service: BSS vendor (SYS-01: billing and customer care)
tier_rationale: CPNI for about 198,000 accounts; supports High-criticality BP-09 and BP-13
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability, Confidentiality)
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; bill print vendor not used by the vendor
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 changes lacked documented approval; remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and removal; federated sign-in with MFA; role assignment; audit and export review; configuration of customer authentication and CPNI approval settings. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2(1), AU-6, IA-8, PT-4. Company gaps: audit review (POAM-005), access reviews (POAM-001), approval checks (POAM-019)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 12 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 8 h for BP-09: **does not meet BIA** (P05 finding 4)
incident_notification_terms: 72 hours after confirming a security incident
follow_up: Negotiate 8-hour RTO and 24-hour incident notice at the 2027 renewal; obtain the hosting provider's SOC 2

tier_rationale: Authenticates every workforce user and backs TACACS+
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: MFA policy, conditional access, administrator role assignment, and session revocation are company CUECs. Mapped to IA-2(1), IA-2(8), AC-2. Company gap: SMS fallback for 40 field supervisors (STD-06 update)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% stated availability; meets BIA (RTO 1 h through break-glass)
follow_up: None beyond the SMS fallback removal

tier_rationale: Hosts the OSS, mediation, CDR archive, portal back end, and backups
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability, Confidentiality)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer is responsible for identities, network rules, encryption keys, logging, and backups (shared responsibility model; P04). Company gaps: CDR read logging (POAM-005), restore tests (POAM-010)
availability_vs_bia: Regional design and second-region backups meet the BIA if restores work (unproven; P05 finding 1)
follow_up: None for the provider; company CUEC gaps tracked in the POA&M

tier_rationale: Privileged EDR agents on every endpoint and server; 24x7 detection for the company
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security) plus annual service review with detection tests
subservice_organizations: SIEM SaaS platform carved out (see VEN-05)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 high-severity escalations missed the 30-minute target; staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must maintain the escalation list, approve containment, define log sources, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Company gap: network element and SYS-15 sources missing (POAM-005)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; MDR continuity plan tested annually per the report
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity
follow_up: Track escalation SLA monthly; add network element use cases to the 2027 statement of work

tier_rationale: Holds 1 year of security logs that include customer identifiers
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer controls data sources, retention settings, and user access. Mapped to AU-9, AU-11, AC-2
availability_vs_bia: Not on the BIA recovery path; logs needed within 8 h to validate recovery

vendor_and_service: SD-WAN and firewall orchestrator vendor (SYS-15; subservice organization for the Business Services SOC 2)
tier_rationale: Configures about 1,900 customer edge devices; supports BP-07
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must manage tenant administrators with MFA, review change logs, and approve firmware schedules. Mapped to AC-2, CM-3, SI-2. Company gap: change approvals (POAM-007)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h; meets BP-07 RTO 4 h only because customer edges keep forwarding traffic without the orchestrator: **acceptable with that dependency noted**
follow_up: Include as a carved-out subservice organization in the company's system description, with its CUECs listed

vendor_and_service: Contact center platform (CCaaS; SYS-11), including the agent assist feature (AI-002)
tier_rationale: Call recordings and transcripts with CPNI for every care call
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Confidentiality)
subservice_organizations: Speech-to-text and language model subprocessor carved out
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls roles (overflow vendor roles), recording notices, and retention. Mapped to AC-3, PL-4, SI-12. Company gap: overflow role showed call detail (POAM-004)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 4 h; meets BIA (BP-09 RTO 8 h)
follow_up: **Agent assist launched 2026-05, after the report period, and its language model subprocessor is carved out.** Obtain the subprocessor's assurance; amend the contract to bar training on company data (POAM-015; P10)

tier_rationale: Reads and updates customer accounts with CPNI through the BSS API
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Confidentiality); Type 1 accepted until the first Type 2
subservice_organizations: Large language model platform provider carved out
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls the API scope, authentication flow, and knowledge content. Mapped to IA-8, AC-3. Company gap: SSN4 fallback (POAM-011)
availability_vs_bia: Not on the critical path (BP-09 can run without the chatbot)
follow_up: Type 2 required by 2027-06-30; contract amendment with CPNI, no-training, 90-day transcript deletion, and 24-hour notice terms by 2026-12-31 (P10)
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Vice President of Regulatory Affairs, 2026-09-03

cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must control vendor access (access broker) and patch the cluster. Mapped to MA-4, AC-17, SI-2. Company gap: vendor access (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Vendor support SLA 4 hours for severity 1; meets BP-06 RTO 1 h only with the in-house standby node
follow_up: Vendor access through the access broker only; add 24-hour incident notice and a SOC 2 commitment at renewal (2027-04)

exceptions_noted: On-site review: no CPNI training; call detail screens visible; clean desk practiced; background checks done
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls roles and training content. Mapped to AT-3, AC-3, PS-7. Company gaps: training and role (POAM-004)
availability_vs_bia: Not on the critical path; in-house agents absorb overflow
follow_up: CPNI training before access; contract amendment with CPNI training, discipline, and 24-hour notice terms by 2026-12-31
reviewer_and_date: Director of Customer Operations and Security Manager, 2026-08-06

availability_vs_bia: Not on the BIA recovery path beyond BP-08 (TTP re-provisions within 4 h)
follow_up: Confirm 24x7 contact details after the SSI refiling (POAM-020)

tier_rationale: Receives bill images with toll call detail (CPNI) for about 120,000 paper bills a month
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Confidentiality)
opinion: Qualified (exception on logical access reviews at the vendor)
